title: Split fix_bluetooth.sh under the cap, deferring steam_compatibility.sh
objective: Bring fix_bluetooth.sh (720 lines) under the 250-line cap using a single multi-lib pass, and confirm that a seam crossing shared mutable state must be abandoned rather than suppressed.
acceptance_criteria: The entry script and all four new libs are at most 250 lines.
The pre-commit shellcheck hook passes on every touched file, with no new suppression and no disable directive.
All four libs are written in one pass, so the entry script sources every lib directly and no lib sources a sibling.
The stubbed run reports every moved function as defined.
No script is executed. fix_bluetooth.sh reloads btusb and restarts bluetooth and PipeWire, which would drop live audio.
steam_compatibility.sh is fully restored to 663 lines, with the unrelated libs already present in the same lib/ directory left untouched.
out_of_scope: Executing any bluetooth or audio fix.
steam_compatibility.sh, whose CACHE_MAP associative array is written in one prospective lib and read by main.
Changing what any script does when run.
verifier: meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh, plus pre-commit run --files over all touched files, plus check_file_length.sh, plus ls of the shared lib/ directory to confirm the revert removed only what it should.
